name: team-onboarding
description: First-run AgentOS setup for a 2-3 person team. Capture all members, team priorities, routines. Mark complete when memory/team/members.md is populated and at least 2 memory/members/<slug>.md exist.

title: Capture team members list
description: Identify everyone on the team. For each: name, slug (URL-safe), Telegram username, role, working hours. Save to memory/team/members.md with user_id → slug mapping.

title: Per-member profile interviews
description: Each team member /starts the bot, operator walks them through their personal profile (expertise, tone preference, deep-work blocks, focus projects). Save to memory/members/<slug>.md.

title: Team priorities for the month
description: Capture current month / quarter priorities. Save to memory/team/shared-priorities.md.

title: Configure shared routines
description: Decide: morning brief — single team-channel post or per-member individual messages? Decision-capture mode — auto-detect or ask? Pre-deadline nudges — to all or only assignee?

title: Verify cross-context routing
description: Test: member A messages 'what is B working on?' — operator pulls B's recent saga activity + recent decisions. Test: member A says '@b could you...' — saga task created, B pinged. Confirm routing works.
